title: The richest people have almost no income
description: A dollar-a-year salary is not modesty and not a stunt. It is the visible end of a mechanism that turns a fortune into spendable cash without ever selling anything, and without ever creating a taxable event.

scenes.narration: The richest people you know report almost no income at all.
scenes.imagePrompt: Empty corner office at night high in a glass tower, one leather chair turned toward floor-to-ceiling windows, city far below reduced to a soft carpet of distant unfocused light points, no buildings close enough to show signage, no people

scenes.narration: Selling their shares would trigger a tax bill above twenty percent, so they never sell.
scenes.imagePrompt: Grand marble lobby of a private bank at night, tall stone columns, polished floor reflecting one chandelier, brass detailing, completely deserted, no signage

scenes.narration: Instead a bank lends against the stock, at a rate close to what entire governments pay.
scenes.imagePrompt: Massive polished steel vault door standing slightly open in a dim stone room, heavy locking bolts and wheel, dramatic raking side light, no markings

scenes.narration: The loan is not income. Loans are not taxed anywhere.
scenes.imagePrompt: Macro of a heavy black fountain pen lying on dark polished wood beside a folded blank sheet of cream paper, warm lamp light from one side, shallow focus, no writing

scenes.narration: They live on borrowed money and never touch the asset underneath it.
scenes.imagePrompt: Empty penthouse living room at night, low modern furniture, floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking a lit city skyline, one lamp glowing, no people

scenes.narration: The shares keep compounding the whole time, the debt sitting quietly behind them.
scenes.imagePrompt: Macro of polished brass balance-scale weights stacked on dark stone, cold directional light, deep shadow, minimal abstract composition

scenes.narration: In America, at death the cost basis resets, and the gain nobody ever taxed disappears.
scenes.imagePrompt: An empty antique leather armchair in a dark wood-panelled library, one green glass banker's lamp lit on a side table, leather-bound books receding into deep shadow, no people

scenes.narration: So the number on the paycheck was never really the point.
scenes.imagePrompt: The same empty corner office at dawn, cold blue light through floor-to-ceiling glass, one leather chair, quiet city far below, no people, no screens
